title: Ploeg authenticated operator API v1
description: GET /api/v1/operator/{teams,summary,unsettled-accounts,work-items,work-items/{id},work-items/{id}/card,cards,runs,runs/{id},events,route-refusals}, and POST /api/v1/operator/work-items/{id}/cancel, which requires execute permission and X-Ploeg-Actor, takes no body and withdraws tracker-originated work; repeating it on a withdrawn or settled item changes nothing and reports withdrawn false. POST /api/v1/operator/work-items/{id}/approve and /reject decide a proposed Work Item a Run created (ADR-0031); both require execute permission and X-Ploeg-Actor and take a JSON body {"reason": string}, required for reject. Approve queues the item; reject closes it as done and releases its allotted budget. Any other state answers 409 not_proposed. Bearer consumers have team scope. Collection after is a decimal bigint cursor; limit defaults 50, maximum 200. Work items filter on team, state, needsHuman=true and the tracker identity provider plus externalId, which must be given together and match across every team in scope unless team narrows it. Detail returns the most recent 200 records per collection, with explicit truncation flags. Audit pagination has snapshot consistency and is not a lossless changefeed: IDs are allocated before commit. Unbound events are omitted. Missing costs and unsupported team pause state remain unknown/null. Text is bounded (16384 characters for descriptions/findings, 4096 for summaries/reasons/URLs), recognizable credentials are redacted, URL queries/fragments are removed. Other credential-bearing structural fields are never selected. A recorded cost is an observation, not proof of final gateway settlement. Summary takes window=24h|7d|30d (default 7d): Work Item counts, pending and running Runs and reservedUsd are current; finished, failed and stuck count Runs finished inside the window by outcome, and settledUsd is spend settled inside the window; lastActivityAt is the Team's latest bound audit event. The Run list is newest first by id with limit 1..200 (default 50), filters team, state and outcome, and pages with before=<runId>, returning nextBefore; teams are scoped by the owning Work Item and externalRef is the tracker reference used in trailers, or empty for manual work. Events take order=asc|desc (default asc); order=desc returns newest first, pages with before=<eventId> and returns that cursor as nextCursor, and lastCursor is the newest event id in the page (0 when empty); after with order=desc, or before without it, is rejected. Timestamps in summary and Run list responses are UTC. The card of a Work Item (ADR-0046) answers schemaVersion 1, a number, and 404 when the Work Item is not in the consumer's scope; a Work Item without a Shift still has a card in state drafting. The card list (ADR-0054) takes member=<login>, repeatable 1..20 times and matched without case, and optional since=<RFC 3339>, team, before=<cursor> and limit 1..50 (default 20). It answers schemaVersion 1, a number, as the card does, with cards in the shape of the card endpoint: the consumer's team-scoped Work Items whose roster or steward names a member, newest activity first. Activity is the latest of the first Run's start, a play first seen or merged, a merged play's first deploy to its release environment, and a confirmed crack's confirmation, mend or mend confirmation, falling back to the Work Item's creation; since keeps cards whose activity is at or after it. nextBefore is an opaque cursor or null; a page examines at most twice its limit, so it can hold fewer cards, or none, while nextBefore is set. Unsettled-accounts takes no query parameters and lists, oldest first and at most 200, the finished Runs in scope whose gateway key the block sweep cannot block (account minting, issued or unknown), each with the budget it still holds; totals cover every such Run in scope, also past the 200th. Route refusals (ADR-0038) lists tracker tasks that routing refused and that therefore have no Work Item: it takes no query parameters and answers the newest refusal of each task refused in the last windowDays (14) days, newest first and at most 50, within the consumer's team scope. A task queued or refreshed after its newest refusal is left out. code is stable; a refusal recorded before codes existed answers unclassified with allowedLabels empty, and reason is the sentence Ploeg also commented on the task. allowedLabels are the repo/ labels the matched board rule allows, empty when no rule matched or the reason is target_not_ready.

number.description: The pull request's number. Null when the link names none.

mergeState.description: Whether the pull request merges into its base branch, as the review poll last confirmed it (ADR-0040). conflicted needs two polls in a row at one head that report a conflict; a new head resets it to unknown. unknown until a forge that reports mergeability is polled, and on a forge that does not. It never changes the Work Item's state.

baseBranch.description: The branch the forge said the pull request targets, or the Work Item's target branch when the forge has not said. Null when neither is known.

checkedAt.description: When the review poll last read the merge state. Null until it has; a failed forge read leaves it unchanged.

changesRequestedBy.description: Each distinct forge login that asked for changes on the pull request, ordered by its newest request first. Empty when nobody did.

mergedAt.description: When the forge merged the pull request (ADR-0045). Absent until a webhook or the review poll reports the merge.

mergedBy.description: The forge login that merged the pull request. Absent when unknown.

headSha.description: The newest head commit the forge reported for the pull request. Absent when unknown.

mergeCommitSha.description: The commit the merge produced on the base branch. Absent when unknown or not merged.

reviews.description: Every review the forge reported on the pull request, oldest first, at most the newest 50. Empty when none was recorded.

state.description: Absent when the forge did not classify the review.

headSha.description: The head commit the review was given on. Absent when the forge did not say.

pinnedScopes.description: Tracker container ids (Vikunja project, ClickUp list) pinned to this team: their items run as this team whoever is assigned, and unassigning withdraws this team's item. Sorted; empty when none. Absent from Ploeg releases that predate the field.

assignees.description: Tracker usernames, lowercased and sorted, whose assignment routes a Tracker Item to this team (config teams.<team>.assignees and PLOEG_TEAM_MAP). Empty when no username routes to the team. Absent from Ploeg releases that predate the field.

usage.description: A Run's usage as its harness reported it, with the cost Ploeg observed. Every field is absent when unknown; the fields after costUsd are kept since ADR-0045.

problem.description: A writing Run's account of what was wrong or missing (ADR-0042), markdown, at most 4096 characters. Empty for a reading Run and for a writer that reported none.

solution.description: A writing Run's account of what it changed (ADR-0042), markdown, at most 4096 characters. Empty for a reading Run and for a writer that reported none.

settledAt.description: When the Run's gateway account was first settled. Absent before settlement and for a Run without an account.

costFinalAt.description: When the settled cost stops being corrected for late gateway charges: the end of the correction window, or settledAt when the settlement opened none.

costFinal.description: True once the Run's cost will no longer change. A settled cost before costFinalAt is provisional and may rise.

withdrawn.description: True when this request withdrew the item; false when nothing was live.

shiftId.description: The Shift this request closed with close reason withdrawn_by_operator.

cancelledRuns.description: Pending Runs that will not start.

stoppedRuns.description: Running Runs finished; each worker stops when its next renew is refused.

keysBlocked.description: False when a model key block is unconfirmed; the controller's block sweep retries it.

approved.description: True when approval queued the Work Item; false when rejection closed it as done (ADR-0031).

settledAt.description: When the Run's gateway account was first settled. Absent before settlement and for a Run without an account.

costFinalAt.description: When the settled cost stops being corrected for late gateway charges: the end of the correction window, or settledAt when the settlement opened none.

costFinal.description: True once the Run's cost will no longer change. A settled cost before costFinalAt is provisional and may rise.

cardStyle.description: The Work Target's cardStyle configuration. A Work Target without one gets skin default and no theme.

cardSteward.description: Who carries the Work Item: the human who merged the latest merged play, else the human who approved last.

cardPerson.description: A human who acted on the Work Item: merged or reviewed a play (forge login), or moved the ticket out of the test gate (qa) or the acceptance gate (acceptor) on the tracker (tracker username, ADR-0051). A cosigner merged the fix that mended one of the card's cracks without being its steward (ADR-0052). Logins Ploeg acts as are left out.

cardCrew.description: The started Runs of one Role. A figure sums the Runs that reported it and is absent when none did.

cardCI.description: The combined commit status Ploeg last read at headSha, at capturedAt.

cardPlay.description: One pull request for the Work Item, as the forge reported it. Every fact the forge has not reported is absent, including state. timeline, ciTiming and shape are the play's review, CI and change figures (ADR-0058), each absent until its facts were captured; ci stays the combined commit status of ADR-0046.

deployments.description: The first deploy of each environment that carried mergeCommitSha, earliest first (ADR-0047). Empty until a deploy is reported.

changedPaths.description: The paths this pull request changes at headSha, in the forge's order. Absent while the paths at the current head have not been read, including after a failed read; an empty array is a read list with no paths.

changedPathsTruncated.description: True when the pull request changes more paths than changedPaths holds. Present exactly when changedPaths is.

cardChangedPath.description: One path a pull request changes. previousPath is the source of a rename or copy.

cardTotals.description: Sums over every started Run. A usage figure sums the Runs that reported it and is absent when none did; usageComplete is false when cost, tokens or a figure present here misses a started Run. costStatus is reserved while budget is still held, observed when a cost was recorded, not_reported otherwise. failedRuns counts Runs that finished failed or stuck. rounds counts distinct Rounds that started a Run. runSeconds sums finished Runs.

cardLive.description: The Work Item's usage so far while at least one Run is running (ADR-0049). Each figure adds the gateway's running total for every running Run to what the finished Runs recorded; runSeconds counts each running Run up to observedAt. costUsd, inputTokens and outputTokens are absent when the gateway could not be read for a running Run. usageComplete is false when a figure present here misses a Run. These figures are a reading, not a settlement: totals stays the record.

cardEvent.description: One step of the Work Item's history. actor is the human who acted, when one did.

card.description: A Run card (ADR-0046): one per Work Item, assembled from stored facts when read. Ploeg sends facts only. state: withdrawn when the Work Item was withdrawn; drafting with no play; in_review while a play is open or its state is unknown; merged when the latest play merged, or a play merged and the Work Item is done; closed otherwise. finish is always matte until that decision is made. rarity is how exceptional the change was (ADR-0056): a cardRarity object once the first Run started, the card was revealed or an epic's set is complete, and null otherwise; older Ploeg versions always sent null. condition holds the confirmed cracks (ADR-0052) and is null without one. grade is computed from stored facts under a versioned formula (ADR-0050) and null until a human approved or requested changes on a play, or a play merged. demo is always false from Ploeg. deployments and release come from the deploys pipelines report to POST /api/v1/deploys (ADR-0047). live is the usage so far while a Run is running, read from the gateway when the card is read, and null otherwise (ADR-0049). gates is the Work Item's path through its board's delivery gates, absent or null when no gate move was recorded; evolved is true when a requirement bounce left acceptance (ADR-0051) or a bug was attributed to the card as a changed requirement (ADR-0052). set places the card in its epic's set from tracker parent relations, and is absent when the Work Item belongs to no epic that counts (ADR-0053). flow holds the card's flow figures (ADR-0057): time in every tracker status, lead, cycle and start time, flow efficiency, blocked time, reopens, queue and agent time, how long the merge took to reach each environment and how long confirmed cracks took to mend, each in elapsed and in working seconds under the team's working calendar; absent from older Ploeg versions. These figures describe the card and the team's process: waiting and blocked time reflect how work flows through the team, never the steward, and they never feed the grade or the rarity. pipeline sums up review and CI across the plays, and shape the change shape of the merged plays (ADR-0058); each is absent when no play carries its figures.

externalRef.description: The tracker reference used in trailers, as in the Run list. Absent for manual work.

deployments.description: The earliest deploy of each environment across the plays, earliest first (ADR-0047).

evolved.description: Present and true when a requirement bounce left the acceptance or done gate (ADR-0051), or a bug was attributed to the card as a changed requirement (ADR-0052).

cardDeployment.description: The first deploy of one environment that carried a play's merge commit (ADR-0047). sha is the deployed commit, url the pipeline run when the deploy named one.

cardRelease.description: When the latest merged play went live (ADR-0047). source deploy: at is that play's first deploy of the release environment. source merge: the repository has never reported a deploy of the release environment, so at is the play's mergedAt. environment is the Work Target's release.environment, default production.

cardGrade.description: The card's grade (ADR-0050). formula names the version of the deterministic formula that computed it. Ploeg computes the grade when the card is read, always under its current formula, so a card read after a formula change shows the new version and the grade it gives. overall = 0.40 reliability + 0.25 durability + 0.20 delivery + 0.15 review, each subgrade rounded to the nearest half (ties up), then overall rounded the same way. provisional is true until the card has been live 180 days, and a provisional overall is at most 9. label is null while provisional; after that it is black when all four subgrades are 10, gold when overall is 10, otherwise null. qualifiers: RV when a play was reverted, HF when a hotfix-labelled fix mended one of its cracks, OB when the recorded cost passed the authorized budget, RT when a Run failed. Formula 2026.2 (ADR-0052) adds crack weight and reverts to reliability and reverts and hotfixes to durability. Formula 2026.3 (ADR-0061) lowers review by 1 per rework round only, caps a subgrade at 9 while one of its inputs is listed in inputs.missing, and gives no label while inputs.missing is not empty. evidenceComplete is true when inputs.missing is empty, so a consumer can show next to the grade whether every input Ploeg can collect was seen; it does not change the formula. inputs are the facts each subgrade used.

cardGradeInputs.description: The facts each subgrade used under the grade's formula. null is a fact Ploeg does not know. notCollected names, as subgrade.input, every input Ploeg has no source for on any card yet; such an input never moves a grade. missing names, the same way, every input Ploeg has a source for but no fact on this card; under formula 2026.3 it caps its subgrade at 9 and withholds the label. The grade's evidence is complete when missing is empty.

reliability.description: crackWeight sums the weight of the card's confirmed cracks (ADR-0052); reverted is true when a play was reverted.

durability.description: daysLive counts whole days since liveSince, the card's release; 0 while the card is not live. reverts counts the pull requests that reverted a play; hotfixes counts the hotfix-labelled fixes of its cracks.

delivery.description: budgetShare is the recorded cost over the authorized budget, null when either is unknown. defectBounces counts defect and unknown bounces, null when the board maps no gates. extraPlays counts plays beyond the first.

review.description: reworkRounds counts the distinct (play, head commit) pairs on which a human requested changes, the only input that lowers review under formula 2026.3. changeRequests counts human reviews that requested changes; reviewRounds counts the distinct (play, head commit) pairs humans reviewed. Under 2026.3 both are context and lower nothing.

cardRarity.description: The card's rarity (ADR-0056): how exceptional its change was, as a challenge score from 0 to 100 under a versioned formula, kept apart from grade (quality), finish (survival), pulls (luck) and sets. Formula 2026.1: score = 100 x (0.30 reach + 0.25 sensitive + 0.20 novelty + 0.25 size), each component from 0 to 1: reach = min(1, ln(max(1, modules) + 3 x (repos - 1)) / ln 12); sensitive = min(1, ln(1 + sensitive files) / ln 9); novelty = novel files / files; size = min(1, ln(1 + counted lines) / ln 2001). A predicted score adds 10 when the card is in an epic's set, capped at 100. Cost, time, tokens, bounces and grade are never inputs. predicted is computed from what was known before the merge (the repositories, the files of earlier merged plays, the current play's diff size and set membership); revealed is computed from the merged plays once the card has a release and every merged play's files are recorded. tier is revealed when present, else predicted, except that an epic's own card is legendary while its set is complete. score, percentile, cohort and inputs describe the revealed moment once revealed and the predicted one before. A tier comes from the score's percentile in its cohort (the same repository and calendar quarter of the reveal, under the same formula): above 99 legendary, above 95 epic, above 85 rare, above 60 uncommon, else common, where percentile = 100 x (1 + cohort scores strictly below) / cohort size. While the cohort holds fewer than 30 cards, fixed thresholds decide instead (85 legendary, 70 epic, 55 rare, 35 uncommon) and percentile is null. A revealed tier, score, percentile and cohort are frozen when revealed and never change after, even as the cohort grows.

oneOf.description: The cards the score is ranked in. target is the card's repository as lowercased owner/name; quarter is the calendar quarter in UTC of the reveal, or of the read while predicted; size counts the revealed cards of the cohort with this card.

revealedAt.description: The release time the card was revealed at, null until revealed.

cardRarityInputs.description: The facts the rarity score used. null is a fact Ploeg does not know; it adds nothing to the score. reach.modules counts the distinct modules touched (a top-level directory, or the first two directories under apps, packages, services, libs, modules, crates, components, plugins or projects; a root file is the module .), reach.repos the distinct repositories. sensitive.files counts the touched files on the Work Target's sensitive ground, and sensitive.paths lists up to 20 of them. novelty.novel counts the touched files that no earlier merged play of the same repository, on another card, touched in the 180 days before this card first touched them. size.countedLines adds the lines added and removed without the files the Work Target leaves out of size. A file left out of size counts for none of these facts. set is whether the card is in an epic's set, and is null on a revealed score. truncated is true when a play touched more files than Ploeg keeps, so the file facts are a lower bound. notCollected names the inputs Ploeg has no source for yet.

cardGates.description: Where the Work Item stands on its board's delivery gates and how it got there (ADR-0051), from the tracker status moves Ploeg recorded. A bounce is a move back to an earlier gate; its reason comes from a bounce:<reason> comment written since the gate it left was entered, else from exactly one bounce:<reason> label, else unknown. rightFirstTime has one entry per gate after development that the Work Item entered: the number of defect and unknown bounces that left it.

cardCondition.description: What confirmed cracks did to the card (ADR-0052). state is cracked while any crack's mend is not confirmed, and mended once every crack has a confirmed mend. Cracks appear only after a person who is neither the steward nor the proposer confirmed them.

cardCrack.description: One confirmed attribution of a bug Work Item to the card. weight is what it takes off reliability: severity (S1 4, S2 2, S3 1, S4 0.25) times share (primary 1 split among the bug's primary causes, contributing 0.25) times discovery (self 0.5, discovered 1, concealed 1.5) times warranty (full 1 up to 180 days live when the bug was raised, half 0.5 up to 365, history 0 after) times the mend (0.5 confirmed by the steward, 0.75 confirmed by someone else, 1 otherwise). confirmedBy is the proposer and the confirmer. disputed is true while a referee has not decided the steward's dispute.

cardCrackMend.description: The merged fix of the crack's bug Work Item. by is the login that merged it, left out when it is a login Ploeg acts as. confirmedAt is null until the mend stood 30 days with the bug Work Item done and no new crack on the card.

crack.description: One attribution of a bug Work Item to the card whose play caused it (ADR-0052). state: proposed by the fixer; confirmed by a second person who is neither the card's steward nor the proposer; disputed by the steward within five working days of confirmation (disputeUntil); unlinked by a referee; evolved when the requirement changed, which gives the card evolved and no crack. confirmedBy is the proposer and the confirmer once confirmed. severity, share and discovery are null only for an evolved attribution. mended is the bug Work Item's merged fix.

crackCandidate.description: An earlier merged play that touched a path the fix touched. share is sharedFiles over the fix's file count; files lists at most 20 shared paths. attribution is the state of an existing attribution of this card to the bug, or null.

crackCandidatesResponse.description: The candidates for a bug Work Item's cause (ADR-0052): plays of other Work Items of its team, in a repository the fix touched, merged within 365 days before the bug Work Item was created (since, until), ranked by shared paths, then newest. Ploeg only proposes; a crack needs people.

cracksResponse.description: Every attribution in which the Work Item is the bug or the card, oldest first, at most 100.

crackResponse.description: The attribution after a proposal, confirmation, dispute, resolution or evolved mark.

cardSet.description: The card's place in its epic's set (ADR-0053). Members are the Work Items of the card's team whose tracker parent is the epic and whose relation Ploeg saw no later than their first Shift. role is epic on the epic's own card (when the epic is a Work Item of the team) and child on a member's. epic.workItemId is null when the epic is not a Work Item of the team. position counts from 1 in the order the members' first Shifts opened, and is null on the epic card. children is listed on the epic card only. complete is true when every member merged, has been live 30 days or more, and has no crack without a confirmed mend.

cardDuration.description: A length of time in elapsed seconds and in working seconds under the team's working calendar (ADR-0057).

cardSpan.description: A measured stretch of the ticket's life (ADR-0057). start names what from is: tracker_created (the tracker's creation time), first_seen (when Ploeg first stored the Work Item, because the tracker did not say), first_active (the first move into an active status) or first_run (the first Run, when it came before any active status). end names what to is: first_active, first_run, merge, release or now. running is true when to is now because the span has not ended; seconds and workingSeconds then grow on every read.

cardFlowStatus.description: The time the Work Item spent in one tracker status or bucket, summed over its visits, up to now for the current one (ADR-0057). gate is the delivery gate the status mapped to when Ploeg recorded the move, null when it maps to none. kind is the board's configured kind for the status, else the default rules of ADR-0057. observed is true when an entry into the status was timed when Ploeg received it rather than when the tracker said it happened.

cardFlow.description: A Run card's flow figures (ADR-0057), computed from stored facts when the card is read. Unknown figures are null, never 0. statuses lists at most 50 statuses in the order the Work Item first entered them; truncated is true when more statuses, or more than 500 recorded moves, existed, and the totals still count every status that was read. statusesSince is the first recorded move, null without one. gates and kinds sum the status time per delivery gate entered and per kind. leadTime runs from the tracker's creation (else Ploeg's first sight) to the release, else to now while delivery is still possible; it is null for a withdrawn card or one whose pull requests all closed. cycleTime runs from the first active status or the first Run, whichever came first, to the release, else the merge of the latest merged play, else now. timeToStart runs from the lead time's start to the cycle's start, or to now before work started. efficiency is active seconds divided by active, waiting and blocked seconds within the cycle, to three decimals, null without recorded statuses in the cycle. blockedSeconds and reopens (moves out of a done status into another kind) cover every recorded move. queueSeconds runs from the first time the Work Item was queued to its first Run; agentSeconds sums every started Run's duration, a running one up to now, and has no working time because agents do not keep office hours. firstRunToFirstPlaySeconds runs from the first Run to the first pr_opened event. mergeTo and mergeToWorking hold, per environment, the time from the latest merged play's merge to its first deploy there; environmentsReached lists those environments in deploy order; timeToProduction is the entry of the release environment, null until a deploy reached it (a release counted from the merge has none). restores holds every mended confirmed crack's time from confirmation to mend, 0 when the mend came first, and meanRestoreSeconds their mean to one decimal. estimateSeconds is the tracker's time estimate (ClickUp time_estimate), null when the tracker keeps none or none was set. calendar is the working calendar the working seconds were counted in. notCollected lists wanted figures without a source: statuses (the board records no status moves), estimate and holidays (the calendar lists none).

cardPlayTimeline.description: When the play moved from opened to merged and how its review went (ADR-0058). Facts only: none of it feeds the grade or rarity, and none of it ranks a person. Waiting for a first review or approval measures how fast the team responded, not the author's work. Durations are whole seconds; null is a fact Ploeg does not know. openedAt is the forge's creation time; readyAt is when the play left draft (or WIP), equal to openedAt when it was never a draft, and null when the forge's activity was never read or the play is still a draft. Feedback is the first review, inline review comment or comment by a human who is neither the author nor a forge login Ploeg acts as; toFirstFeedbackSeconds and toFirstApprovalSeconds run from readyAt and never go below zero. lastApprovalAt is the latest such approval at or before the merge, and approvalToMergeSeconds runs from it. reviewRounds counts the distinct head commits humans reviewed, as the grade does. comments counts the comments and inline review comments of those humans, reviewers the distinct humans who submitted a review. responseSeconds is the median time from a request for changes to the author's next push. commits counts the play's commits (a lower bound when truncated), firstCommitAt is the earliest author date, codingSeconds runs from it to readyAt, and forcePushes is null on a forge that does not report force pushes (GitLab). capturedAt is when the forge's activity was last read, null when only webhook reviews are known.

toFirstFeedbackSeconds.description: Seconds from readyAt to the first human feedback.

toFirstApprovalSeconds.description: Seconds from readyAt to the first human approval.

approvalToMergeSeconds.description: Seconds from the last approval before the merge to the merge.

openToMergeSeconds.description: Seconds from openedAt to the merge.

responseSeconds.description: Median seconds from a request for changes to the author's next push.

codingSeconds.description: Seconds from the earliest commit's author date to readyAt.

cardPlayCITiming.description: How the play's CI runs went (ADR-0058), read from the forge at its capture points; no log is read. A run is a Forgejo Actions run, a GitLab pipeline, or the checks one commit reported without either (source statuses). runs counts runs across every head commit; failedRuns those that ended in failure or error; reruns the repeat runs on an unchanged commit (a second run of the same workflow on the same commit, or a job's second attempt), a flakiness signal. lastGreenSeconds is the wall time, queue excluded, of the latest successful run on the play's head (its merged head once merged). queueSeconds adds the seconds each job attempt waited for a runner. timeToGreenSeconds runs from the play's readyAt to the first time every workflow of one head commit was green. minutes adds the duration of every job attempt. slowest lists up to three jobs by their longest attempt. firstPassGreen is whether the first run on the head that was ready for review succeeded without a rerun; null while it runs or when it was cancelled or skipped. truncated says the read reached its bound, so counts are a lower bound. Facts only; never part of the grade or rarity.

cardComplexity.description: Indentation complexity of the change (Hindle, Godfrey and Holt, 'Reading Beside the Lines: Indentation as a Proxy for Complexity Metrics', ICPC 2008): each added or removed line counts its logical indentation level, one per tab or per indent unit of spaces, the unit detected per file from the diff. added and removed sum those levels, net is their difference, maxDepth is the deepest added line and hotspots the files with the most added complexity. A language-agnostic proxy, not McCabe complexity; method names the measure's version. Files the Work Target leaves out of size count nothing.

cardPlayShape.description: How large, tested and complex the merged play's change was (ADR-0058), measured once at the merge from its changed files and its diff, of which only these numbers are kept. Every figure leaves out the files the Work Target leaves out of size (lockfiles, generated and vendored code, ADR-0056). files counts the remaining changed files and countedLines their lines added and removed. testLines counts the lines of test files and testRatio divides them by the other counted lines (null when a file's lines are unknown or nothing else changed); test and documentation files match the Work Target's cardShape patterns or the defaults. docsTouched counts documentation files. languages names up to three languages by file extension, most lines first. complexity is null when the diff was not read. truncated says the file list or the diff reached its bound, so the figures are a lower bound. Facts only; never part of the grade or rarity.

cardShape.description: The change shape of the card's merged plays added up (ADR-0058). plays counts the merged plays that were measured and complete says every merged play was. Counts and lines add up; a figure a measured play does not know is null. files adds each play's files, so a file two plays touched counts twice. complexity adds up, keeps the deepest maxDepth and merges hotspots by path; it is null when a measured play has none. Facts about the change, not the people on it.

cardPipeline.description: Review and CI summed up across the card's plays (ADR-0058), from each play's timeline and ciTiming. plays counts the plays that carry either. toFirstFeedbackSeconds is the first such play's, openToMergeSeconds the latest merged play's, and firstPassGreen the first play's. reviewRounds and comments add up the plays that know them. median holds the median of each figure over the plays that know it. ci adds up the plays whose CI was read, and is null when none was. Waiting for a review reflects the team's response, not the author's work. These figures describe the change: they never feed the grade or rarity and are never totalled per person. Team pages may aggregate them per team; a client sees team aggregates only.
